content: rate-limiter-flexible (v11.2.0) ships RateLimiterRedis/Memory/Mongo/MySQL/Postgres/Cluster/Queue/Union/Bursty classes, all modeling requests-per-duration token buckets. It has no concurrency/semaphore primitive (N-concurrent-slots-held-until-released). For a tenant+lane concurrency cap, either hand-roll a small Redis Lua INCR/DECR-with-cap-check pair (TTL as crash safety net) or adopt the dedicated npm package redis-semaphore (swarthy/redis-semaphore, Lua-atomic, ioredis-based, built-in lease refresh) -- verified OK via package-legitimacy check, actively maintained.
